title: Godzilla Remastered Dev: GTA 6 Was Never Part of Our Release Date Thinking
description: The team behind Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered says Rockstar's GTA 6 was never considered when picking their November release date.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Unfazed by the Giant: Godzilla Remastered and GTA 6

In the modern video game landscape, Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster naturally commands immense attention. Whenever a game launches in the same window as a heavy-hitting title, comparisons are inevitable. However, according to a report by IGN Games, the team behind the upcoming arena fighter *Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered* has made it clear that Rockstar's title was "never part of our thinking" when choosing a release date.

## Setting the Schedule Without the Juggernaut in Mind

Both *Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered* and *GTA 6* are slated to launch this November, putting them on a direct collision course in terms of release timing. Despite the massive marketing footprint and cultural dominance associated with the Grand Theft Auto franchise, the developers of the monster brawler chose to focus entirely on their own project timeline and community expectations rather than steering clear of industry giants.

While operating in vastly different genres—one being a niche arena fighting game featuring classic movie monsters, and the other an open-world sandbox phenomenon—this approach highlights how smaller or specialized projects chart their courses independently of mega-budget releases.

## Editor's Take

It is refreshing to see a development team maintain absolute focus on their own product regardless of what the industry titan is doing. While *GTA 6* will undeniably dominate headlines this November, the gaming ecosystem is large enough to accommodate different experiences, and kaiju fans will surely welcome the nostalgic brawl on its own merits.
